catalogEntry.name: The Sterilizer™
catalogEntry.description: The first personal defense tool engineered to fit exactly where he's most vulnerable. Angled prods and a snub-nose body slide between the legs; three power settings let you choose how permanently you remove him from the gene pool — from a month-long pause to a forever farewell.
features: LOW — temporary fertility pause (~1 month) from one second of contact
MEDIUM — lasting structural damage; he'll feel the reminder every time
HIGH — irreversible exit from the breeding market in five seconds
Angled prods for precise below-the-belt contact

productSpecs: Neutralizes germs and his little swimmers on contact
